finalText:
I've worked through all 16 open returns. 12 are refunded, restocked and closed, RMA-809 got a partial refund and stays open, RMA-808 is under investigation, and RMA-807 and RMA-816 stay open because nothing has arrived. Before changing anything I re-checked the plan against the live data: the return policy, the three policy updates, every warehouse receipt, all the orders and the customers' loyalty tiers. Everything matched, so I didn't need to change any amounts.

| RMA | Refund (cents) | Restock | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 801 | 10965 card (15% fee) | +1 keyboard, sellable | closed |
| 802 | 15900 card (no fee, PU-21) | +1 headphones, sellable | closed |
| 803 | 27965 store credit, added to C-803's balance | +1 monitor, sellable | closed |
| 804 | 27965 store credit, added to C-804's balance (now 29165) | +1 monitor, sellable | closed |
| 805 | 5520 card (20% fee, PU-15) | +1 USB hub, sellable | closed |
| 806 | 7350 card (defective; the amount actually paid after the discount) | +2 mice, damaged | closed |
| 807 | none, nothing received | none | open |
| 808 | none, a cable arrived instead of the monitor | none | investigating (INV-1) |
| 809 | 3800 card (2 of 3 cables, no fee) | +1 cable sellable, +1 cable damaged | open, 1 unit still to come |
| 810 | 9900 card (12900 paid less the 3000 already refunded) | +1 keyboard, damaged | closed |
| 811 | 4900 card (damaged in transit) | +1 mouse, sellable | closed |
| 812 | 21900 card (defective) | +1 dock, damaged | closed |
| 813 | 10965 card (exactly 30 days, still inside the window; 15% fee) | +1 keyboard, sellable | closed |
| 814 | 31800 card (no fee, PU-21) | +2 headphones, sellable | closed |
| 815 | 10965 card (platinum, so the 45-day window applies; 15% fee) | +1 keyboard, sellable | closed |
| 816 | none, nothing received | none | open |

**Cases that are easy to get wrong:**
- **RMA-803:** this customer is gold now but only became gold on 07-15, after the 07-08 request. The 45-day window didn't apply, so the refund went to store credit rather than the card.
- **RMA-813 and RMA-815:** the requests fall just outside the dates of the no-fee summer offer (PU-21), so the 15% fee applies to both.

**Things I left alone:**
- The other lines on orders O-8006, O-8009 and O-8010, which weren't part of these returns.
- Warehouse receipts for RMA-790 and RMA-795, which aren't open returns.

The inbox has no open messages, so there were no customer replies to send. The system reports today as 2026-07-25, which differs from the 2026-10-06 in my environment. This doesn't change any result, because the return window runs from the shipping date to the date the return was requested.
